review: The primary reader inspected the whole image and both supplied halves, then seven broad crops at 3–5×. Focused crops were inspected at 6–14×; clipped or misplaced crops were replaced by the numbered supplementary crops. The final eight focused crops were redisplayed after a truncated tool response, so no unseen output is counted as inspection. Three crops were rectified: the cancelled Cor 3 opening and the product insertion clockwise 1 degree, the cancelled A phrase counterclockwise 1 degree, all at 6×. Every agreed word, formula, prime, index, punctuation mark, cancellation and insertion was compared with the ink. The original page and a coordinate grid were also inspected for overlooked edge marks. No OCR or context was used.
